items.coaching_cue: Lift shoulders off mat through the upper three-quarters, controlled tempo, exhale on the way up.
Steady brisk pace on incline, light effort, easy nasal breathing throughout.

week2-progression-increase.why: feedback loop: top reps hit → increase (S-GEN-10)

week.focus: Full Body A - Squat emphasis with horizontal push/pull

items.name: Barbell Back Squat
items.coaching_cue: Brace core, break at hips and knees together, drive through midfoot, keep chest tall, track knees over toes.

items.name: Barbell Bench Press
items.coaching_cue: Retract and depress scapulae, slight arch, lower bar to lower chest with control, drive feet into floor.

items.name: Bent-Over Barbell Row
items.coaching_cue: Hinge to about 45 degrees, pull bar to lower ribs, squeeze shoulder blades, keep neutral spine, no jerking.

items.name: Dumbbell Lunges
items.coaching_cue: Step forward into a controlled lunge, descend until back knee nears floor, keep torso upright, alternate legs.

items.name: Alternating Hammer Curl
items.coaching_cue: Keep elbows pinned to ribs, neutral grip, controlled eccentric, no body swing, alternate arms smoothly.

week.focus: Full Body B - Hinge emphasis with incline press and vertical pull

items.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
items.coaching_cue: Upper back on bench, chin tucked, drive through heels, full hip extension, squeeze glutes hard at top.

items.name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
items.coaching_cue: Bench set 30 to 45 degrees, lower bar to upper chest, press in slight arc back over shoulders, feet planted.

items.name: Close-Grip Lat Pulldown
items.coaching_cue: Slight forward lean, pull elbows down and back toward hips, squeeze lats at bottom, control the return.

items.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
items.coaching_cue: Slight elbow bend, lead with elbows not hands, raise to shoulder height, pause, lower under control, no shrugging.

items.name: Barbell Curl
items.coaching_cue: Elbows pinned and slightly forward, full ROM, squeeze biceps at top, controlled 2 to 3 second eccentric.

week.focus: Full Body C - Goblet squat variation with chest, row, and calf emphasis

items.name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat
items.coaching_cue: Hold dumbbell vertically at chest, sit between heels, knees track over toes, chest up, full depth if mobility allows.

items.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
items.coaching_cue: Press dumbbells from chest level in a slight arc, lock out over shoulders, full stretch at bottom, controlled tempo.

items.name: Dumbbell Incline Row
items.coaching_cue: Chest supported on incline bench, pull dumbbells to hips, squeeze shoulder blades together, no torso rotation.

items.name: Cable Chest Press
items.coaching_cue: Step forward into split stance, press handles out and slightly together, controlled return, constant cable tension.

items.name: Standing Calf Raises
items.coaching_cue: Full stretch at bottom on a slight edge if available, drive up onto big toes, peak contraction, 2 to 3 second eccentric.

week2-progression-pain.why: feedback loop: pain logged → decrease or substitute (S-GEN-11)

week.focus: Full body A - lower-body emphasis (barbell back squat substituted due to prior-week pain)

items.name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat
items.coaching_cue: Hold dumbbell vertical at chest; sit hips back; keep torso tall. Anterior load avoids bar-on-spine stress.

week.focus: Full body B - upper-body emphasis with LISS cardio

items.name: Barbell Side Split Squat
items.coaching_cue: Step wide; keep torso upright; track knee over toes.
Steady conversational pace; cool-down after lifting block.

week.focus: Full body C - balanced with posterior-chain emphasis

items.name: Chin-Up
items.coaching_cue: Use assisted machine or band if needed; controlled descent, chin clearly above bar.

items.name: Back Squat
items.coaching_cue: Brace core, sit between hips, track knees over toes, drive midfoot into floor.

items.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
items.coaching_cue: Set shoulders back and down; lower under control until upper arms parallel floor, press dumbbells together at top.

items.name: Bent-Over Dumbbell Row
items.coaching_cue: Hinge at hips with neutral spine; pull elbows back and squeeze scapulae at the top.

items.name: Alternating Hammer Curl
items.coaching_cue: Keep elbows pinned to sides; rotate from elbow, not wrist; full ROM.

items.name: Standing Calf Raises
items.coaching_cue: Full stretch at bottom, rise onto balls of feet, brief pause at top; control descent.

week.focus: upper body horizontal and vertical emphasis

items.name: Barbell Bench Press
items.coaching_cue: Retract and depress scapulae; bar to lower chest; drive feet into floor and press in a slight arc.

items.name: Chin-Up
items.coaching_cue: Start from dead hang; pull chest to bar leading with elbows; avoid kipping. Use assist band or machine if needed.

items.name: Leverage Shoulder Press
items.coaching_cue: Glutes seated on bench; press in arc finishing handles over mid-shoulder; don't shrug.

items.name: Cable Rope Rear Delt Rows
items.coaching_cue: Pull rope to forehead level with elbows high; pause and squeeze rear delts; control return.

items.name: Barbell Curl
items.coaching_cue: Elbows pinned in front of body; curl through full ROM without torso swing; squeeze at top.

week.focus: full body balanced with posterior chain emphasis

items.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
items.coaching_cue: Upper back on bench edge; tuck ribs down; drive heels and squeeze glutes to full hip extension at top.

items.name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
items.coaching_cue: Bench around 30 degrees; bar to upper chest; press up and slightly back over shoulders.

items.name: Close-Grip Front Lat Pulldown
items.coaching_cue: Slight backward lean; pull bar to upper chest; lead with elbows and squeeze lats at bottom.

items.name: Dumbbell Lunges
items.coaching_cue: Take a long step; keep front knee tracking over midfoot; torso upright; alternate or stay on one side if grip is limiting.

items.name: Ab Crunch Machine
items.coaching_cue: Curl ribs toward hips; avoid pulling with arms; slow controlled tempo, breath out on contraction.
